name: serena
description: Expose the project-scoped Serena MCP singleton for symbol-aware navigation, topic memories, targeted read-only discovery, on-demand dashboard access, and refactors in Secret Faeries.

interface.shortDescription: Use the shared Secret Faeries Serena MCP for symbol-aware navigation, topic memories, targeted reads, and refactors
